job: fbl1: first long episode on the Facebook Page, native video
approval: Only run this after Mostafa's own yes in the Buffer thread naming this job (Claude asked him at 09:34 UTC Oct 20). Without it, do nothing.
steps: 1. In your own Chrome window/tab, open Meta Business Suite for the Page «مصطفى ديشو». Check that no Egypt-Sudan long video is already posted or scheduled (on Oct 18 the only long episode there was Elon Musk). If it is already there, stop and report.

2. Find the Egypt-Sudan master under D:\1deishoo channel (see FILES\social\fb-long-episodes-check.md). READ/COPY ONLY: copy it to D:\rtmp; never move, rename or edit anything in D:\1deishoo channel. It must match the YouTube version https://youtu.be/T84u1ievIsw (17:47). If the local file is a different length, stop and report before uploading.
3. Upload it as a native video (not a reel, not a link post) on the Page and schedule it for Wed 2026-10-21 21:00 Cairo (UTC+3).
4. Never type passwords. If Meta asks for login or 2FA, stop and tell him. Chrome must be closed 18:55-19:15 Cairo.
5. When Meta shows the upload finished and the post is scheduled, delete only the D:\rtmp copy. Report the scheduled time and the post/video id or URL.
title: هل بدأت الحرب بين مصر والسودان؟ الحقيقة كاملة
